name: Cathedral, Torre Civica and Piazza Grande, Modena
description: In the heart of Modena, northern Italy, this Romanesque cathedral was begun in 1099 and consecrated in 1184. Its façade is covered in vivid stone carvings by the sculptor Wiligelmus, designed with the architect Lanfranco. Beside it rises the Ghirlandina bell tower, and together they overlook the open Piazza Grande, the city's historic gathering place.
